_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. foodnoms.com's declared design layer is the ~90 --token-* colour names its Framer stylesheets put on <body> (raw/css-vars.json); everything else is measured computed style (raw/components-computed.json). Two authored themes: the same stylesheet redeclares 39 of those names under prefers-color-scheme: dark, so 'dark' names the same variables and resolves each through the emulated dark pass — the theme a dark-system visitor actually gets. Leaves either name a variable ('var', resolved in that theme) or carry a measured value with its source ('value' + 'source').
